name: corpse_kindred_burns
about: A Kindred's corpse burns and is removed ten seconds after the death, seen or not. sp_tutorial_1's sabbat_redshirt_1 (npc_VVampire, stattemplate TutorialShovelhead, spawnflags 4: a placed row, not a maker child, so it carries neither Flag_InfChild nor Flag_Fade) verbatim on the east pad, unhidden at 0.5 s (the row is StartHidden 1), the player at the start WATCHING it; TakeDamage 10000 at 2 s. CreateCorpse 0x1032c0e0's burn arm: burn = 0x10207df0 (the template's Has_Burning_Death, or Kindred without Disallow_Kindred_Death) -> BurnModel 0x10090580 and SUB_Remove 0x101c0b10 armed at curtime + 10.0 (0x1032c32f), unconditionally: no view cone, no PVS, no FVisible (stories/v4/packets-S1.md item 1; stories/v1/triage.md, Judge's rulings, V4 -- second sitting, J13). So one `removed` on the corpse at death + 10 s (by death + 10.5 s), none before death + 9.5 s.
notes: Death at 2.0-2.1 s: death + 10.5 s is 12.6, death + 9.5 s is 11.4. BurnModel's look (the burn overlay, the ash) is filed to 0014; this record states the clock only. GREEN on the V4a seam's build (removed at death + 10.0 s while watched), so it carries no known_red; V4c's C integrator and V4d lane D (a simulating body removed at + 10 s must not ensure) must keep it green.
